packet_bolt.notes: PACKET GUN bolt: a data packet (header bar, flipping bits) with an arrow head and a shrinking pixel trail. Points right; rotate to the travel direction. Anchor = the packet centre (44,12). Loop frames 0-3.

packet_hit.notes: PACKET GUN impact: square shock frame + flying bits. Centre (24,24). Frames 0-4, once.

firewall_brick.notes: FIREWALL wall segment: three courses of glowing red brick topped with flames. Upright; base centre (28,68). Stand them along the ring every ~34 px. Loop frames 0-7.

key_head.notes: ENCRYPTION KEYS: a glowing key (ring bow left, toothed shaft right). Points right; rotate to the orbit tangent. Anchor = middle of the shaft (24,24). Loop frames 0-7.

quarantine_emblem.notes: QUARANTINE zone centre emblem: a turning trefoil in a tick ring (3-fold symmetric, seamless). 80x80, centre (40,40). Draw at 1x or 2x, ~80% alpha. Loop frames 0-7.

quarantine_pylon.notes: QUARANTINE containment pylon, stood on each of the 8 corners of the zone. Base centre (14,52). Loop frames 0-5.

quarantine_drop.notes: QUARANTINE drop-in: a square cage slams down over the target spot with a flash and shock ring. 160x160, centre (80,80). Play once when a zone is placed. Frames 0-7.

mine_idle.notes: LOGIC MINE. Frames 0-3 = arming (slow dim light), frames 4-7 = armed (fast red blink, lit prongs). Centre (20,22). Loop the half that matches the mine's state.

mine_blast.notes: LOGIC MINE explosion: white flash, layered fireball, ring, debris and late smoke. 192x192, centre (96,96), fireball radius ~76 at full size. Play once; scale 1x or 2x to the blast radius. Frames 0-9.

scanner_hub.notes: SCANNER base: radar plate with an antenna arm pointing right (+x). Rotate to the sweep angle. Centre (32,32), blinking LED. Loop frames 0-7.

scanner_blip.notes: SCANNER hit: a radar blip - expanding green ring + X lock. Centre (24,24). Frames 0-5, once.

backdoor_door.notes: BACKDOOR: a glitching purple door. Frames 0-3 open (play once during the 0.25 s opening), 4-7 idle glitch loop. Base centre (28,76).

backdoor_boomerang.notes: BACKDOOR boomerang: two curved purple blades with gold tips, spinning (2-fold symmetric, seamless). Centre (24,24). Loop frames 0-7 (play ~2 loops per 0.67 s for the fast spin).

backdoor_slash.notes: BACKDOOR hit: a glitching X-slash with offset slice bars. Centre (28,28). Frames 0-4, once.

ping_hit.notes: PING.EXE hit: nested square echo rings with a '!' flash. Centre (32,32). Frames 0-5, once.

evo_railgun_beam.notes: RAILGUN beam, rotate to aim. 3 parts: left cap x0-96 (muzzle at x=48,y=48), body tile x96-288 (tile it, seamless), right cap x288-384 (impact point at x=336). Frames 0-7, play once over ~0.6 s; thins out from frame 3.

evo_railgun_hit.notes: Spark burst on every enemy the beam pierces. Centre = (32,32). Frames 0-5, play once.

evo_inferno_flame.notes: One flame cluster for the SCORCHED EARTH ring. Upright (fire rises, never rotate). Base centre = (24,76). Stand them along the ring every ~26 px, each with its own frame offset and an optional horizontal flip. Loop frames 0-7.

evo_inferno_pillar.notes: Fire geyser for the SCORCHED EARTH eruption. Base centre = (32,138). Spawn them in an expanding wave (delay by distance from the player). Frames 0-9, play once.

evo_tesla_strike.notes: TESLA GRID hit: forked bolt falls from the top (0-5), a glowing 5x5 node lattice flashes on the ground, double shock ring + sparks. Origin = point of impact (56,160). Play once on every target the grid strikes. Frames 0-9.

evo_tesla_coil.notes: Emitter glyph under the player while TESLA GRID is equipped: four pylons arcing round a pulsing core. Centre = (48,48); draw it a few px below the player's feet. Loop frames 0-7.

evo_blizzard_flake.notes: A drifting snowflake, 24x24, centre (12,12). Scatter many inside the ABSOLUTE ZERO area, fall + sway them in code, each with its own frame offset; draw at 1x or 2x. Loop frames 0-7.

evo_blizzard_crystal.notes: Ice crystal cluster standing on the rim of the ABSOLUTE ZERO area. Upright (never rotate). Base centre = (32,84). Loop frames 0-5 (a sparkle climbs the tallest spike).

evo_blizzard_glyph.notes: Frost rune under the player (hexagram + snowflake + tick ring), 224x224, centre (112,112). Draw at ~50% alpha at 1x, below the player. Loop frames 0-7 (6-fold symmetric, seamless).
